exposure: prenatal sonographic features (congenital diaphragmatic hernia, fetal overgrowth)
outcome: diagnosis of Simpson-Golabi-Behmel (SGBS) syndrome type 1 and type 2
cohort: The study included four male fetuses with pre- or postnatal diagnosis of Simpson-Golabi-Behmel syndrome.
finding: Detailed sonography followed by selective and graded molecular diagnostics (microarray techniques and whole exome sequencing) can increasingly differentiate syndromes in fetuses presenting with congenital diaphragmatic hernia (CDH).
